items.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. ONE original wide 16:9 illustration for a Japanese junior-high textbook introducing Miyazawa Kenji's public-domain story about a white elephant. Main central scene: inside a spacious old wooden farm shed stands ONE large gentle white Asian elephant beside a traditional mechanized rice-threshing machine. The machine is recognizable as a wooden and iron farm machine with a turning drum and wheel, and harvested rice stalks stacked nearby, not a modern tractor. Show the scene in a large illustrated storybook with two Japanese junior-high students in plain uniforms viewing it from the lower foreground, outside the story. Elephant has normal Asian elephant proportions and calm expressive eyes; no costume, chains, suffering, villain or violence, no recognizable modern franchise design. Friendly hand-painted watercolor/flat style, soft blue/green and warm ochre, clear subject, simple uncluttered barn. No lettering, numerals, paragraph lines, logos, brand names, labels, writing on machinery, watermark or copied textbook artwork. Single finished scene, no variants.
items.contentReview: 白い象と稲こき機械・稲束・木造の大きな小屋を確認。物語の絵を見る生徒2人。機械の文字やロゴなし。

items.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. ONE original wide 16:9 friendly Japanese junior-high textbook illustration for writing a personal essay about a small meaningful everyday experience. Three first-year junior-high students in plain school uniforms sit at a classroom table, thinking and discussing a memorable everyday moment while preparing to write in open notebooks. One student recalls a surprising small rain shower and rainbow on the walk home, shown in a small wordless thought bubble with only the simple scene; another smiles and gestures toward the memory; another holds a pencil above a blank page. Emphasize noticing an experience and thinking about why it matters, not presenting a finished written answer. Soft warm hand-painted educational style, rounded expressive characters, muted blue/green/orange, clean layout, simple classroom window and plants. ALL paper, notebook pages, book spines and thought bubbles must be completely text-free: no letters, numbers, printed lines, Japanese characters, logos or watermark. No copied characters or textbook art. One finished image, not a grid.
items.contentReview: 身近な雨と虹を思い出し、随筆の題材を話す3人。ノートは文字なし、思い出も絵だけ。
